title: Design System v1 — tokens, components and two motion profiles
description: Base layer for building pages: 12-step neutral ramp, semantic colors, type scale 12-60px with tracking rules, 4px spacing grid, radius/shadow scales. Components: pills, buttons, topbar, sidebar, inputs, tables, cards, tabs, avatars, toggles, menus, tooltips, alerts, progress. Motion Profile 1 (Framer soft: springs 100/30 + 100/10 extracted from Nuria bundle) and Profile 2 (cinematic: scroll-pin, kinetic type, lightning, magnetic, parallax - Storm Lab vocabulary). Zero dependencies, prefers-reduced-motion safe.
origin: user-directed build (2026-10-22): user asked for small-UI primitives layer + Framer motion DNA from supplied references (Nuria, Storm Lab, Genesis)

approval.note: user reviewed component showcase + Odyssey motion render and said 'this is great, thanks, at least its nicer now'; page templates built on this layer still require per-template review

usage.rule: page templates import tokens.css + components.css; add exactly one motion profile; compose components only from tokens
usage.motion_js: include motion.js (profile 1) and/or motion-cinematic.js (profile 2) with defer

conformance: prefers-reduced-motion honored in both profiles; no external requests; fonts self-hosted by consuming template
